roles.label: Business Operations Architect
roles.headline: Business Operations Architecture | Information Architecture | Operational Systems
roles.summary: Business Operations Architect focused on discovering how functions actually operate, including the informal information flows and dependencies that sustain delivery. Connects separately maintained information, reconciles business definitions and ownership, and designs sustainable operational systems that support coherent decisions without displacing functional accountability.

roles.label: Enterprise / Business Architect
roles.headline: Business Architecture | Enterprise Information Architecture | Transformation
roles.summary: Business-focused architect who makes complex organisations more understandable by connecting operating models, information flows, governance and technology. Discovers actual practices and hidden dependencies, then translates them into coherent structures, shared definitions and sustainable foundations aligned with how the organisation needs to operate.

roles.label: Digital Transformation Leader
roles.headline: Digital Transformation | Business Systems | Process & Data Enablement
roles.summary: Transformation leader who starts by understanding how work actually happens—including informal handoffs, information flows and workarounds—before redesigning it. Combines process discovery, information architecture, workflow redesign and practical technology to reduce fragmentation, improve governance and build solutions people can adopt.

roles.label: Strategy & Transformation
roles.headline: Strategy & Transformation | Operating Model | Decision Intelligence
roles.summary: Strategic transformation practitioner who makes organisational complexity understandable by exposing hidden dependencies, fragmented information and decision gaps. Works across functions to clarify operating realities, align governance and design information systems that improve leadership visibility and execution coherence.
